statement: UNWIND $inputs AS s RETURN s AS input, trim(string.regexReplace(apoc.text.join([fold_char IN split(normalize(replace(replace(toLower(normalize(s, NFKC)), 'ß', 'ss'), 'ς', 'σ'), NFKC), '') | coalesce($digits[fold_char], fold_char)], ''), '[\\s\\x{0b}\\x{1c}-\\x{1f}\\x{85}\\p{Z}]+', ' ')) AS output
